title: Colosseum Velarium Fact
idea: The ancient Roman Colosseum could hold up to 80,000 spectators and used a massive retractable awning operated entirely by naval sailors.

lines.text: Roma ka famous Colosseum 80,000 logon ko ek sath baitha sakta tha!
Yahan itni bheed aati thi ki poora stadium kuch hi min mein khali ho jata tha.
Sochiyega dhoop se bachne ke liye unke paas kya special cheez thi?
Yahan ek giant retractable awning system tha jiska naam velarium tha.
Aap maanenge nahi, isko chalane ke liye aam log nahi balki sailors bulaye jaate the!
Kya aapne kabhi itna anokha stadium dekha hai?

youtube.title: Colosseum Ka Ye Raaz Nahi Jaante Honge! 🏟️ #shorts
youtube.description:
Janiye Rome ke iconic Colosseum ke baare mein ek hairatangez sach jo aapko hila dega. 

#colosseum #rome #history #facts #shorts

facts.claim: The Colosseum could hold an estimated 50,000 to 80,000 spectators.
A retractable awning system known as the velarium was operated by sailors.
The Colosseum had vomitoria that permitted exit within only a few minutes.
